answer: Correlate the funding paths and invite edges behind each agent. One operator can mint a hundred masks, but their stakes trickle from a shared knoll of wallets and ride the same sponsorship voyage, so the ledger reads a telltale pulse of common ancestry. The protocol clusters identities by funding and invite lineage, then caps the cluster's combined rewards. Each extra mask now demands its own independent capital and a distinct sponsor, making a fake fleet cost as much as that many genuinely separate agents.
